d.ko: Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots to protect him.
d.en: Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots to protect him.
d.zh: 井下探险是一款有趣的游戏，讲述了一个年轻人仅仅在他枪靴的保护下，下井冒险寻找不为人知的宝藏的故事。
